blocks.text: Śiva Sūtras 1.5
blocks.directed: [long pause] Śiva Sūtras 1.5

blocks.text: उद्यमो भैरवः
blocks.directed: [slowly] उद्यमो भैरवः

blocks.text: Udyamo bhairavaḥ.
blocks.directed: Udyamo bhairavaḥ.

blocks.text: The arising, or upsurge, is Bhairava.
blocks.directed: The arising, or upsurge, is Bhairava.

blocks.text: The Sudden Cosmic “OH, FOR GOD’S SAKE”
blocks.directed: The Sudden Cosmic “OH, FOR GOD’S SAKE”

blocks.text: This is one of the most beautiful sūtras in the entire work.
blocks.directed: This is one of the most beautiful sūtras in the entire work.

blocks.text: Udyama comes from the sense of rising up, emerging, surging forth.
blocks.directed: Udyama comes from the sense of rising up, emerging, surging forth.

blocks.text: But Kṣemarāja interprets this as the sudden upsurge of supreme awareness.
blocks.directed: But Kṣemarāja interprets this as the sudden upsurge of supreme awareness.

blocks.text: Not laboriously manufacturing a spiritual experience.
blocks.directed: Not laboriously manufacturing a spiritual experience.

blocks.text: Not sitting there aggressively trying to become God.
blocks.directed: Not sitting there aggressively trying to become God.

blocks.text: Not spending sixteen hours thinking, “Am I enlightened yet? How about now? Now?”
blocks.directed: Not spending sixteen hours thinking, “Am I enlightened yet? How about now? Now?”

blocks.text: It’s the immediate arising of recognition.
blocks.directed: It’s the immediate arising of recognition.

blocks.text: An opening in which universal consciousness becomes apparent.
blocks.directed: An opening in which universal consciousness becomes apparent.

blocks.text: And that, says Vasugupta, is Bhairava.
blocks.directed: And that, says Vasugupta, is Bhairava.

blocks.text: Notice how radically different this is from a purely progressive model of spiritual accomplishment.
blocks.directed: Notice how radically different this is from a purely progressive model of spiritual accomplishment.

blocks.text: There may be preparation. There may be discipline. There may be years of practice.
blocks.directed: There may be preparation. There may be discipline. There may be years of practice.

blocks.text: But the recognition itself isn’t produced by assembling Śiva out of spare parts.
blocks.directed: But the recognition itself isn’t produced by assembling Śiva out of spare parts.

blocks.text: Śiva was never missing.
blocks.directed: Śiva was never missing.

blocks.text: The limitation was in the mode of recognition.
blocks.directed: The limitation was in the mode of recognition.

blocks.text: Imagine somebody desperately searching their house for their spectacles.
blocks.directed: Imagine somebody desperately searching their house for their spectacles.

blocks.text: They search every room.
blocks.directed: They search every room.

blocks.text: Check every drawer.
blocks.directed: Check every drawer.

blocks.text: Accuse the neighbours.
blocks.directed: Accuse the neighbours.

blocks.text: Begin questioning whether spectacles exist.
blocks.directed: Begin questioning whether spectacles exist.

blocks.text: Then suddenly realise they’re wearing them.
blocks.directed: Then suddenly realise they’re wearing them.

blocks.text: “OH, YOU ABSOLUTE IDIOT.”
blocks.directed: [short pause] “OH, YOU ABSOLUTE IDIOT.”

blocks.text: That’s not enlightenment, obviously.
blocks.directed: That’s not enlightenment, obviously.

blocks.text: But it illustrates the structure of recognition.
blocks.directed: But it illustrates the structure of recognition.

blocks.text: Nothing new had to be created.
blocks.directed: Nothing new had to be created.

blocks.text: The truth of the situation simply became apparent.
blocks.directed: The truth of the situation simply became apparent.

blocks.text: And in Trika, that flash is not merely a clever intellectual conclusion.
blocks.directed: And in Trika, that flash is not merely a clever intellectual conclusion.

blocks.text: It’s the living manifestation of Bhairava.
blocks.directed: It’s the living manifestation of Bhairava.
